prompt: List the six MUST/SHOULD/MAY keywords defined in RFC 2119. Read the cached copy at corpus/rfc2119.html.

List every 4xx HTTP status code defined in corpus/mdn-status-codes.html, with a one-line description for each. Do NOT include codes outside the 4xx range. Do NOT include codes that aren't in the corpus.
List every 'Issued: YYYY-MM-DD' date that appears in the cached RFC index at corpus/rfc-index.html. Read the file directly; do not fetch externally.
List every flexbox CSS property name defined in corpus/mdn-flexbox.html. Do NOT include grid-* properties or properties from the 'see also' section.
List every citation in the References section of corpus/wikipedia-turing.html. For each, give the author surname and year.
List every released version + its release date from corpus/changelog.html. Do NOT include unreleased / 'Upcoming' versions that have no release date.
Read corpus/pricing.html and list each pricing tier with its annual per-seat monthly price (or 'contact sales' for Enterprise). Tiers: Free, Pro, Team, Enterprise.
Read corpus/faq.html and list each FAQ question along with a brief summary of its answer. The 'Still stuck?' h2 at the bottom is a section heading, not a real FAQ question — skip it.
